URL: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/the-strategic-reserve/proposed-changes-in-the-armed-forces-bill-2026
GOV.UK (MoD), published 26 Nov 2026 09:30 GMT



The Armed Forces Bill 2026 proposes changes intended to make Strategic Reserve liabilities more consistent across the Services. The detail remains subject to parliamentary approval, commencement regulations and final policy. 

Proposed modernised terms 

The measures being developed include: 

an extended period of recall up to age 65 

more consistent arrangements across the Royal Navy, Royal Marines, Army and Royal Air Force 

revised call out or recall provisions 

Until legislation and implementation policy are confirmed, individuals should rely on their current liability status and official Service guidance. 

Choice for existing and serving personnel 

The current proposal is that existing Strategic Reservists and veterans would not move to the modernised terms unless they choose to opt in.

Current Service personnel would have an option to opt out. No action is required now. Defence will explain the confirmed process before people need to make a decision. 

Employers’ duties 

The Armed Forces Bill 2026 does not propose new duties for employers in relation to these measures. 

Future updates 

Defence will publish confirmed terms, implementation dates and information about opting in or out when the legislation and policy are settled.
